name: AI SDK Agent
summary: The agent layer of Vercel's open-source AI SDK for TypeScript. ToolLoopAgent wraps a model and a set of tools in a reusable loop with stop conditions and per-step control; AI SDK 7 adds a durable WorkflowAgent and a HarnessAgent that drives existing harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex or Pi. Aimed at TypeScript developers building agents into Node.js, Next.js, React, Vue or Svelte apps.
goodFor: Switching model providers behind one API
watchOut: AI SDK 7 requires Node.js 22+ and ESM only
Frequent major versions with breaking changes
Durable execution leans on Vercel's Workflow SDK
